title: Vintage 1982 Playboy Playmate Wall Calendar Gina Goldberg Tomasino Incomplete
conditionDescription: Incomplete: January and March pages are missing; February and April through December are present. Pen marks (circled dates, an X, a crossed-out note) on several months. Spiral binding intact. See photos.
descriptionText:
Vintage 1982 Playboy Playmate wall calendar, spiral bound. Includes Gina Goldberg (February) and Jeana Tomasino (August); photography by Ken Marcus.

INCOMPLETE: the January and March pages are missing. February and April through December are present. Several months have pen marks (circled dates, an X, a scribbled-out note) - see photos.

Adult collectible - sold to buyers 18+ only. Ships flat in a plain, protective mailer.
